Both tests pass:
- ✅ `rejects normalized root before lookup` — `" root "` is normalized to `"root"`, matched as reserved, returns `{ error: "reserved_user_id" }` with zero DB calls
- ✅ `preserves an ordinary local hit` — `"42"` flows through normally to the DB lookup

The fix inserts a single ternary branch after the empty-check: if `normalizedId === "root"`, return `{ error: "reserved_user_id" }` immediately, before any `capabilities.users.getById(...)` call.
